_comment: This manifest is only for the one-time protected credential-remediation coordinator.
It cannot authorize an application deploy, a database phase, release finalization, or ordinary bootstrap.
The ordinary deployment manifest requires Predeploy taskboard readiness, which this mode skips;
this manifest instead requires the uniquely named Credential remediation readiness job.
The workflow numeric id and path are pinned so a same-name workflow cannot supply evidence.
The coordinator must also enforce the freshness window against run_started_at.

required_jobs.name: Repository validation
required_jobs.why: all repository, security, supply-chain, type, test, smoke, and build gates passed at the exact remediation SHA

required_jobs.name: CodeQL analysis
required_jobs.why: isolated JavaScript and TypeScript code scanning completed at the exact remediation SHA

required_jobs.name: Windows checkout and SPEC gate
required_jobs.why: the exact remediation SHA passed the case-insensitive checkout and SPEC contract

required_jobs.name: Credential remediation readiness
required_jobs.why: all taskboard structure checks passed and the only unfinished predeploy row is PROD-SECRET-SCANNING-ALERTS-OPEN with status BLOCKED

required_jobs.name: Control-plane restore interruption drill
required_jobs.why: the candidate control plane remains recoverable across interruption before the protected subset is installed

required_jobs.name: Narrow task follow-up database contract
required_jobs.why: the candidate still passes the isolated database contract even though remediation is not authorized to change a database

required_jobs.name: Migration replay and release contracts
required_jobs.why: the candidate still passes migration and rollback contracts even though remediation is not authorized to run them in production

required_skipped_jobs.name: Predeploy taskboard readiness
required_skipped_jobs.why: ordinary deploy readiness must not run in credential-remediation mode

required_skipped_jobs.name: Release-final taskboard completion
required_skipped_jobs.why: credential remediation cannot claim postdeploy release closure

notes: Every required job must exist exactly once and conclude success.
Every required_skipped_jobs entry must exist exactly once and conclude skipped.
A run that satisfies this manifest necessarily fails the ordinary required-jobs manifest because its ordinary Predeploy taskboard readiness job is skipped.
